newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Three killed in factional fighting in Mogadishu.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in factional fighting in Mogadishu.

text.p: At least three people were killed and more than seven wounded in fighting between rival Somali militias in the south of the capital Mogadishu overnight, hospital sources said on Friday.
The factions, led by Hussein Mohamed Aideed and Osman Hassan Ali Atto, exchanged mortar bombs into the mid-morning, shaking the residential areas of Hodon and Hawlwadag.

About 12 people have been killed this week in fighting between the former allies. They fell out in 1995 when Aideed's late father, Mohamed Farah Aideed, was the dominant force in south Mogadishu. Atto had been his financier and righthand man.
The latest fighting appears to be for control for a strategic junction on the road south out of the city.
